english.note: Use 獨生 before 仔, 女, or 子女 when the child has no siblings at all.

exampleSentences.english: I’m an only child, so I had no brothers or sisters growing up.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我係獨生仔，細個冇兄弟姊妹。
